tasks.label: RSpec: Run all specs
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bundle exec rspec

tasks.label: RSpec: Run current file
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bundle exec rspec ${relativeFile}

tasks.label: Rails: db:migrate
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bin/rails db:migrate

tasks.label: Rails: db:rollback
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bin/rails db:rollback

tasks.label: Rails: routes
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bin/rails routes

tasks.label: Rails: console
tasks.command: docker compose exec -it notification-api bin/rails console

tasks.label: RuboCop: Run
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bundle exec rubocop

tasks.label: RuboCop: Autocorrect
tasks.command: docker compose exec notification-api bundle exec rubocop -a
